title: acalypha hassleriana var. genuina
intro: Acalypha hassleriana var. genuina, commonly known as 'Calabouço', is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Acalypha hassleriana var. genuina include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which make it effective in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antiseptic, and antiparasitic effects.
